authority: User answers in the 2026-11-25 I23 electron-bath coupling session. Recorded verbatim in HELIUM_ADMISSION_20261125.md.

bath.frame_note: at rest in the frozen LSO event frame; frozen environment
bath.spatial_temporal_model: uniform and constant over the whole domain; no lunar wake/shadow structure; no solar-wind drift
bath.label: controlled verification bath, not lunar plasma; measured forcing remains R4.1/D06

products.model: production HeliumElectronImpact::Compose, inherited-parent-velocity reduced electron reservoir
products.bath_terms: one incoming and two outgoing electrons, signed

admission.observable_scope: heavy-particle number, charge and mass budgets and event chronology only; no He+ velocity, energy or pickup observable

threshold_state.rate_fit_threshold_source: D05 Voronov cfit.dat He row (24.6 eV)
threshold_state.excited_ion_yield: unknown; the CCC diagnostic fraction above the He+(n=2) onset (<=9.81%) is recorded as energy eligibility, not a yield
threshold_state.admitted_bound: the source-derived |fit - physical| threshold difference (about 0.0126 eV) plus evaluation-rounding allowance only
threshold_state.quotation_note: The approval question quoted the NIST value as 24.587387 eV. The authenticated profile record (ionization energy/hc = 1.9831066637(20)e7 m^-1) gives 24.5873890 eV; the 2e-6 eV quoting discrepancy does not change the approved rule. The generator uses only the authenticated source value.

conditional_mean.rule: maximum absolute d ln k / d ln T error = published Kim (1992) minus Voronov analytic-slope-equivalent spread at 10 eV
conditional_mean.interpretation: model spread, not a confidence interval

recoil.rule: approved reservoir RMS impulse bound S = sqrt(2 me Ein) + sqrt(4 me Eout), evaluated by the composer at the UPPER end of the admitted slope error
recoil.note: conservative upper-end values approved in place of the central 1.073 km/s and 0.0239 eV

mechanical_limits_He.basis: same numbers as the approved Na P02 limits (M3_P02_NUMERICAL_BUDGET.json), approved for He/He+/electron

startup_controls.decision: explicit .in keys, following the tracked-H precedent

status_limits: No observational agreement, physical excited-state or electron-energy claim, measured-forcing claim, moving-target extension, I23 formal PASS or M3 closure is granted. Numerical conservation tolerances and the 2%/3%/0.3% I23 gates are unchanged.
